comment: CATALOG-BAKE-1 (apex-071): HAND-CURATED per-model wire semantics — the single place O/H-class per-model values live (comb doc config-row-comb-20260918.md section 3 field classes). v2 (operator-adjudicated 3-delta, 2026-09-19): the merged generated+overlay catalog bakes IN PLACE into default_models.json (upstream shape: role pins + models array), so this file also carries the role pins (default/web_search/image_description/session_summary) and the `bake` list — overlay-only models that must ride the merged catalog (seed migration; grok-4.5 is not on the proxy). The gate (scripts/catalog_gate.py) is FAIL-CLOSED: REQUIRED_FIELDS = api_backend + model_family must be present on every entry, and every generated model needs a complete entry — a missing curation is a build failure, never a silent bless. Seed migration: the pre-bake seed rows (grok-4.6, grok-4.5, gpt-5.6-sol) migrate byte-for-value into their entries; config-derived fields win on collision (grok-4.6 supports_backend_search=false; sol 5-item O-class menu beat the old 6-item seed menu). New-model api_backend rulings follow the codebase slug-inference convention (xai-grok-sampling-types/src/catalog_wire.rs) so the curation equals the effective wire: o-series + gpt-5+ + gpt-4.1/gpt-4o => responses; gpt-4.x chat / gpt-3.5 / embeddings => chat_completions. C-class (operator ruling, CATALOG-CCLASS-SEED-1 / apex-byc, 2026-09-19): context_window + max_completion_tokens are C-class — the generated catalog is the proxy's truth for the baked caps, config.toml rows remain the top runtime override, and overlay entries for models that ARE in the generated catalog (on the proxy) must not carry them (the gate fails closed on FORBIDDEN_OVERLAY_FIELDS; the merge never lets an overlay cap beat a generated cap). Overlay-only models (not on the proxy — grok-4.5 bake-listed, gemma-4-31b between-build) may carry them: the overlay is the sole source of caps for those rows. Excluded by design: base_url + env_key ([endpoints] defaults cover them). gemma-4-31b is overlay-only by design (between-build config row; it bakes once listed in `bake`). Precedence UNCHANGED: config row > live fetch > baked catalog > fallback. Anthropic rows are pinned to messages explicitly — never left to inference.
